command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: create opsadmin user"
sudo -n useradd -m opsadmin
id opsadmin

echo "STEP: pick a test-only unrelated user to verify denial (use existing 'operator' - not creating new)"
id operator || true

echo "STEP: write /etc/cron.allow with root and opsadmin"
printf 'root\nopsadmin\n' | sudo -n tee /etc/cron.allow >/dev/null
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/cron.allow
sudo -n chown root:root /etc/cron.allow
cat /etc/cron.allow

echo "STEP: verify cron.deny irrelevant when cron.allow present (leave as-is, empty)"
cat /etc/cron.deny

echo "STEP: verify root can install a crontab"
printf '* * * * * /bin/true\n' | sudo -n crontab -u root -
sudo -n crontab -u root -l

echo "STEP: verify opsadmin can install a crontab"
printf '* * * * * /bin/true\n' | sudo -n crontab -u opsadmin -
sudo -n crontab -u opsadmin -l

echo "STEP: verify a non-listed user (operator) is denied"
set +e
printf '* * * * * /bin/true\n' | sudo -n crontab -u operator - 2>/tmp/deny_test.log
DENY_RC=$?
set -e
echo "operator crontab install exit code: $DENY_RC"
cat /tmp/deny_test.log

echo "STEP: cleanup test crontabs for root and opsadmin (remove the test job we added, keep users allowed)"
sudo -n crontab -u root -r
sudo -n crontab -u opsadmin -r
sudo -n crontab -u root -l 2>&1 || true
sudo -n crontab -u opsadmin -l 2>&1 || true
